<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY ent_resolved 'parameter-resolved'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &ent_resolved;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binData SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Initial root level comment -->
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
  <child sub:id="1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like strings: <child>&complex;</child>
    ]]>
  </child>
  <sub:child id="2">
    &complex;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY macro_ent 'macro-val'>">
  %local_macro;
  <!ENTITY combined "&macro_ent; and more">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY ext_file SYSTEM "external.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<database xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/db" xmlns:meta="http://schemas.example.org/meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment placed right after root start -->
  <meta:info>
    <?meta-pi command="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA section with entities inside: &combined;
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record>&combined;</record>
</database>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second">
  <!ENTITY ent3 "&ent2; Third">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext_param "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext_param;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/catalog/ns">
  <!-- Comprehensive structural comment -->
  <ns:note>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with special characters: <>&"' inside catalog note.
    ]]>
  </ns:note>
  <item>&ent3;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!ENTITY % p_ent "<!ENTITY delta 'γ Delta'>">
  %p_ent;
  <!NOTATION ps SYSTEM "application/postscript">
  <!ENTITY postscript SYSTEM "doc.ps" NDATA ps>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment inside archive root -->
  <?archive-ctrl action="init"?>
  <entry xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload with reference: δ
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <html:div>
    δ
  </html:div>
</archive>
```

  <!ELEMENT system (node*)>

  <!ENTITY eA "EntityA">
  <!ENTITY eB "&eA; EntityB">
  <!ENTITY eC "&eB; EntityC">

  %parser_macro;
  <!NOTATION json SYSTEM "application/json">
  <!ENTITY jdata SYSTEM "data.json" NDATA json>
]>
<?xml-processing-directive key="value"?>
<system xmlns="http://example.org/system" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/system/config">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       detailing system configuration 
       and entity expansion tests -->
  <cfg:setting>
    <?cfg-pi action="load-config"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with embedded xml-like tags: <node>&eD;</node>
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <node>&eD;</node>
</system>
